# Setup -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman", repos = "https://cran.rstudio.com/")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyr, dplyr, ggplot2, lubridate, tibble, stringr,
               knitr, broom, fixest, here)
```

# Import ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false
# Load anonymized store-level data
# Note: StoreName, StreetAddress, ZipCode, City, Longitude, Latitude are not present
load("../data/u_processed/monthly_panel_stores_AT_DE_FR.RData")
stores_panel <- monthly_panel_stores_AT_DE_FR
```

# Preprocess: Build complete store-month panel ----------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

# Extract unique German stores (fields available in anonymized data)
all_stores <- stores_panel %>%
  filter(Country == "DE") %>%
  distinct(MerchantStoreID, MerchantID, CategoryID, StoreCategory,
           Country, StoreCreationDate, StoreContractedDate,
           StoreOnboardedDate, ContractEndDate, NUTS3)

# All observation months
all_months <- tibble(
  Month = seq(as.Date("2019-01-01"), as.Date("2024-12-01"), by = "month")
)

# Cross-join: every store × every month, filtered to active contract period
store_month_grid <- all_stores %>%
  cross_join(all_months) %>%
  filter(
    Month >= floor_date(StoreOnboardedDate, "month"),
    is.na(ContractEndDate) | Month <= floor_date(ContractEndDate, "month")
  )

# Existing transactions
existing_checkouts <- stores_panel %>%
  filter(Country == "DE") %>%
  select(MerchantStoreID, Month, CheckoutCount)

# Join — missing months get 0 transactions
panel_stores_DE_complete <- store_month_grid %>%
  left_join(existing_checkouts, by = c("MerchantStoreID", "Month")) %>%
  mutate(CheckoutCount = replace_na(CheckoutCount, 0))
```

# Add variables: cohort, chain type, tenure -------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

panel_stores_DE_complete <- panel_stores_DE_complete %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = case_when(
      StoreOnboardedDate < "2021-01-01" ~ "2020_or_earlier",
      StoreOnboardedDate < "2022-01-01" ~ "2021",
      StoreOnboardedDate < "2022-07-01" ~ "2022_H1",
      StoreOnboardedDate < "2023-01-01" ~ "2022_H2",
      StoreOnboardedDate < "2023-07-01" ~ "2023_H1",
      TRUE                              ~ "2023_H2"
    ),
    chain_type = case_when(
      StoreCategory %in% c("NATIONAL_CHAIN", "INTERNATIONAL_CHAIN")               ~ "Chain",
      StoreCategory %in% c("NATIONAL_CATERING_COMPANY",
                           "INTERNATIONAL_CATERING_COMPANY")                      ~ "Catering",
      StoreCategory %in% c("UNIVERSITY_CANTEEN", "SELF_OPERATED_CANTEEN")         ~ "Canteen",
      StoreCategory %in% c("RETAIL_CHAIN")                                        ~ "Retail",
      TRUE                                                                         ~ "Independent"
    ),
    month_store             = floor_date(StoreOnboardedDate, "month"),
    month_obs               = floor_date(Month, "month"),
    months_since_onboarding = 12 * (year(month_obs) - year(month_store)) +
                              (month(month_obs) - month(month_store)),
    moy  = factor(month(Month)),
    year = factor(year(month_obs))
  )

# Remove early (pre-2021) and right-censored (2023-H2) cohorts
panel_stores_DE_complete <- panel_stores_DE_complete %>%
  filter(cohort != "2020_or_earlier", cohort != "2023_H2")
```

# Descriptive Statistics --------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

# Cohort tenure trajectories (median transactions)
cohort_comparison <- panel_stores_DE_complete %>%
  filter(months_since_onboarding >= 0, months_since_onboarding <= 12) %>%
  group_by(cohort, months_since_onboarding) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_transactions   = mean(CheckoutCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_transactions = median(CheckoutCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_zero            = mean(CheckoutCount == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_stores            = n_distinct(MerchantStoreID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Okabe-Ito colors for cohorts
cohort_colors <- c(
  "2021"    = "#0072B2",
  "2022_H1" = "#56B4E9",
  "2022_H2" = "#E69F00",
  "2023_H1" = "#D55E00"
)

# Save median-transactions plot for supplement
p_median_transactions <- ggplot(cohort_comparison,
                                aes(x = months_since_onboarding,
                                    y = median_transactions,
                                    color = cohort)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = cohort_colors) +
  labs(x = "Months since onboarding",
       y = "Median container transactions") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(here::here("assets", "objects", "fig-median-transactions.png"),
       plot = p_median_transactions, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Main Model: Poisson TWFE ------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

mod_onb_0_12 <- fepois(
  CheckoutCount ~ cohort + chain_type | moy + NUTS3 + months_since_onboarding,
  cluster = ~ MerchantStoreID + NUTS3,
  data    = panel_stores_DE_complete %>%
    filter(months_since_onboarding >= 0, months_since_onboarding <= 12)
)
```

# Save model outputs ------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

# Raw coefficient table
cohort_coef_table <- as.data.frame(coeftable(mod_onb_0_12))
cohort_coef_table$Term <- rownames(cohort_coef_table)
cohort_coef_table <- cohort_coef_table %>%
  select(Term, Estimate, `Std. Error`, `z value`, `Pr(>|z|)`) %>%
  rename(SE = `Std. Error`, z = `z value`, p = `Pr(>|z|)`)

dir.create(here::here("assets", "objects"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(cohort_coef_table, here("assets", "objects", "cohort_coef_table.rds"))

# Model statistics
cohort_model_stats <- list(
  n_obs    = nobs(mod_onb_0_12),
  n_stores = n_distinct(
    panel_stores_DE_complete %>%
      filter(months_since_onboarding >= 0, months_since_onboarding <= 12) %>%
      pull(MerchantStoreID)
  ),
  pseudo_r2 = fitstat(mod_onb_0_12, "pr2")[[1]],
  loglik    = as.numeric(logLik(mod_onb_0_12)),
  bic       = BIC(mod_onb_0_12)
)
saveRDS(cohort_model_stats, here("assets", "objects", "cohort_model_stats.rds"))
```

# Table: Cohort Analysis (in-notebook view) -------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| label: tbl-cohort-full1
#| tbl-cap: "**Cohort analysis: transaction activity by adoption cohort and establishment type.** Poisson fixed-effects regression; outcome is monthly container transactions per store. Reference categories: 2021 adoption cohort; canteen establishment type. ***P < 0.01; **P < 0.05; *P < 0.1."
#| echo: false

stars_fixest <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
         ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
                ifelse(p < 0.01, "**",
                       ifelse(p < 0.05, "*",
                              ifelse(p < 0.1, "†", "")))))
}

var_labels <- c(
  "cohort2022_H1"      = "Cohort: 2022-H1",
  "cohort2022_H2"      = "Cohort: 2022-H2",
  "cohort2023_H1"      = "Cohort: 2023-H1",
  "chain_typeCatering" = "Type: Catering",
  "chain_typeChain"    = "Type: Chain",
  "chain_typeIndependent" = "Type: Independent",
  "chain_typeRetail"   = "Type: Retail"
)

ct_df <- as.data.frame(coeftable(mod_onb_0_12))
ct_df$term <- rownames(ct_df)

se_col <- grep("Std", names(ct_df), value = TRUE)[1]
p_col  <- grep("^Pr", names(ct_df), value = TRUE)[1]

rows_coef <- ct_df %>%
  transmute(
    Term  = recode(term, !!!var_labels, .default = term),
    Value = sprintf("%.3f%s (%.3f)", Estimate, stars_fixest(.data[[p_col]]),
                    .data[[se_col]])
  )

rows_ref <- tibble(
  Term  = c("Cohort: 2021 (ref.)", "Type: Canteen (ref.)"),
  Value = c("—", "—")
)

cohort_rows <- rows_coef %>% filter(grepl("^Cohort:", Term))
type_rows   <- rows_coef %>% filter(grepl("^Type:", Term))

rows_ordered <- bind_rows(
  rows_ref %>% filter(grepl("Cohort", Term)),
  cohort_rows,
  rows_ref %>% filter(grepl("Type", Term)),
  type_rows
)

rows_fe <- tibble(
  Term  = c("Month-of-year FE", "Region (NUTS-3) FE", "Months since onboarding FE"),
  Value = c("Yes", "Yes", "Yes")
)

rows_stats <- tibble(
  Term  = c("Observations", "Log Likelihood", "BIC"),
  Value = c(
    format(nobs(mod_onb_0_12), big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(logLik(mod_onb_0_12))),
    sprintf("%.2f", BIC(mod_onb_0_12))
  )
)

tab_export <- bind_rows(
  rows_ordered,
  tibble(Term = "", Value = ""),
  tibble(Term = "Fixed Effects", Value = ""),
  rows_fe,
  tibble(Term = "", Value = ""),
  rows_stats,
  tibble(Term = "", Value = ""),
  tibble(Term = "Note: Standard errors clustered by restaurant and NUTS-3 region.", Value = ""),
  tibble(Term = "†p < 0.1; *p < 0.05; **p < 0.01; ***p < 0.001", Value = "")
)

knitr::kable(
  tab_export,
  format     = "pipe",
  escape     = FALSE,
  row.names  = FALSE,
  col.names  = c("", "Months 0-12"),
  align      = c("l", "r")
)
```
